required_review_dimensions.description: Every tested governed provider attempt is representable with the frozen normalized identity/timing/outcome/semantic/authority fields.
Arbitrary provider/model/profile values flow through aggregation and rendering without fixed known-provider display branches.
Failed attempts remain separate durable telemetry records after later retries or success.
Attempt indices are unique within request/candidate/slot execution identity and routing metadata cannot bypass duplicate detection.
Separate workflow runs of the same review request remain distinct dashboard execution envelopes without changing the frozen attempt schema.
Provider latency is nonnegative and v7 uses monotonic elapsed timing where available while wall-clock timestamps remain UTC evidence.
Credential profiles are visible identities but secret values, bearer tokens, and Authorization material are rejected or sanitized before persistence/rendering.
Provider transport failure cannot be represented as promotable semantic success, and telemetry does not derive or upgrade semantic disposition.
Telemetry authority effect remains NONE_PENDING_DETERMINISTIC_INGESTION and cannot authorize merge/release/deploy/completion.
Requested and returned serving-provider identities are separately observable where available without widening model/provider identity claims.
Reviewer v7 emits one secret-safe telemetry-attempt-N record per attempted provider call, including failure paths.
The review workflow passes attempt/profile identity, preserves per-attempt files, and uses normalized retryability evidence without erasing prior attempts.
Per-run review/provider summaries are deterministic and dashboard history merges run summaries without attempt-index collisions across reruns.
Dashboard publication discovers Governance Candidate Platform Review artifacts and renders supplied provider/review groups generically.
R1, R2, and R3 slot values and multiple credential profiles are represented through common telemetry paths rather than slot-specific UI logic.
Existing request-integrity, review-protocol, and semantic-review governance tests remain green on the exact candidate.
The candidate makes no provider uptime/model quality/billing/cryptographic model identity or production authority claim beyond tested observability.
Adversarial search finds no secret leak, retry-history loss, provider omission, rerun collision, semantic laundering, authority widening, or provider-specific dashboard bypass inside scope.
